item.title: Core Scientific to quit Bitcoin mining by year-end as AI business surges
item.description: The former Bitcoin mining heavyweight plans to become a pure-play data center provider in 2027, with mining now accounting for just 7.5% of quarterly revenue.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: American Bitcoin’s $126M profit masks mining pressure as rivals turn to AI
item.description: The Eric Trump-backed miner reported $126 million in quarterly net income, largely driven by gains on its Bitcoin holdings, despite rising mining costs and shrinking margins.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: Asian crypto exchanges batten down the hatches as hacks surge: Asia Express
item.description: Asian crypto exchanges are scrambling to tighten security on fears of a wave of potentially AI-assisted hacks, even as regional governments embrace tokenization and stablecoins.

item.title: Crypto ally French Hill wins reelection but set to lose House chair
item.description: Republican French Hill secured another term in Congress but will lose his leadership of the House Financial Services Committee when Democrats take control in January.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Binance, Deribit revoke SignalPlus API keys after fake Teams invite attack
item.description: SignalPlus said attackers compromised an engineer’s computer in a breach that resulted in losses of less than $82,000, which the crypto trading platform pledged to reimburse in full.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Fed, OCC check US banks after Binance hack as experts flag security risks

item.title: Europe’s largest asset manager Amundi tokenizes equity index fund on Ethereum
item.description: The new share class offers blockchain-based exposure to an index tracking 600 companies across European markets.

item.title: Paraguay president resigns after collapse of Ueno digital bank
item.description: Santiago Peña stepped down amid mounting scrutiny over his former ties to Ueno Bank’s parent company, as the lender’s collapse left millions of customers unable to access their funds.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitcoin crashes 6% to 7-week low as US stocks erase election gains
item.description: Bitcoin saw sudden downside at the Wall Street open as stocks witnessed a snap sell-off, reversing post-election gains.

item.title: Can decentralized phone networks power the AI revolution?
item.description: Decentralized AI networks want to turn everyday phones into an alternative to centralized computing infrastructure — but skeptics have their doubts.

item.title: Trump’s memecoin ventures derailed CLARITY Act, Scaramucci says

item.title: Thailand to block Bitget in December over unlicensed crypto trading

item.title: Bitcoin win rate vs. S&P 500 recovers as post-midterm history favors stocks

item.title: South Korea seeks 4th crypto tax delay, targets 2029 start

item.title: France budget rejection sidelines stablecoin tax, wallet reporting

item.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs draw $128M as crypto rebounds after midterms

item.description: Polygon block producers have already frozen the stolen tokens, but a proposed hard fork would allow the funds to be recovered and returned to their owners.

item.title: ‘Lawyer up’: Democrats target Trump, Big Tech after midterm sweep
